attempts.summary: Configured a persistent firewalld firewall on node1 (RHEL 7): SSH is allowed from any source (default public zone), TCP/9000 is allowed only from node2 (10.100.190.11, via a dedicated source-based firewalld zone "node2-9000") and rejected from node3 and everywhere else (reject rich-rule in the public zone). All three managed nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, with boot-identity change and full service/rule recovery confirmed on each before moving to the next.
